articles.title: Phillies-Rays: John Kruk out, Cole Hamels in on NBC Sports Philadelphia for wild-card fight
articles.description: NBC Sports Philadelphia will have a bit of a broadcast shuffle as the Phillies look to clinch a wild-card spot.

articles.title: Phillies will need Game 162 to get into the playoffs, or complete their collapse after another loss to Rays
articles.description: With the Phillies’ 12-1 loss to the Rays, their drawn-out collapse has become a five-alarm fire of humiliation. They will need Sunday to decide their fate.

articles.title: Bill Giles, the former Phillies owner who helped create the Phillie Phanatic, has died at 92
articles.description: Once described as “Philadelphia’s resident combination of P.T. Barnum and Walt Disney,” Mr. Giles got creative trying to attract fans. The biggest draw was the mascot he green lit in 1978.

articles.title: The Phillies are on the verge of the worst collapse in the city’s sports history. That says something.
articles.description: The goal now is to avoid infamy. It is to preserve legacy. It is to summon the last shred of political capital they earned in 2022 and escape from Game 162 with a reason to believe.

articles.title: Don’t blame Don Mattingly for the Phillies’ Game 1 collapse. Can the season be saved?
articles.description: Monday could have been avoided had the Phils added more last winter or been more aggressive at the trade deadline.

articles.title: Phillies’ chances of clinching a wild card put on hold with 4-1 loss to the Brewers
articles.description: The Phillies finished 0-for-12 with runners in scoring position and Aaron Nola allowed four runs across six innings.

articles.title: Phillies move up start time of Sunday's game vs. Rays due to rain
articles.description: The Phillies said the earlier start time should provide the best opportunity to play Sunday’s regular-season finale without interruption.

articles.title: Phillies to start Aaron Nola in Game 3 vs. Braves; Zack Wheeler expected to follow
articles.description: Nola will be on full rest four days, and Zack Wheeler is expected to be available out of the bullpen on three days’ rest.

articles.title: The same structural failures cost the Phillies again in the playoffs. The onus falls on Dave Dombrowski
articles.description: The Phillies are a top-heavy team in both phases of the game. Dombrowski’s biggest failure over the last three-plus years has been his inability to address either.

articles.title: For the Phillies, suddenly it’s summer as they play the Braves in Atlanta
articles.description: In Philly, this has been an "unusually" gloomy September. It will be considerably brighter in Atlanta. Whether the Phillies experience a Red October remains to be seen, but they are in for a Red ...
